topic: Cheech: live on Google Play, iOS next (one store at a time)
caption:
Cheech, our ride-sharing app, is live on Google Play, and iOS is on its way to the App Store. 🚗

Launching on one store first is a common path, and for many founders a smart one:

▸ Real users arrive sooner
▸ You learn and fix on one platform before the next
▸ Each store has its own review, so you deal with one at a time

With a shared codebase like React Native, the second platform doesn't mean starting over.

Planning your app's launch? DM us APP and we'll help you map out the rollout.

Share this with a founder getting ready to launch. 🔁
